about: Ordering, Group by and sorts, shared by the Rust commands (src-tauri/src/todo.rs) and the browser mock (src/lib/ipc/mock-todo.test.ts). Same step language as todo-rules.json, plus: pref{key,value} saves a Todo Preference (group_today, group_upcoming, group_inbox, group_all, inbox_sort, lists_sort, done_in_lists); the runners start every case with group_today = none, like the older cases. reorder{task,before?,after?,target?} moves a Task between its neighbours (before is directly above its new place, after directly below; Tasks by index, a literal string is an id) into the group whose adopted properties are target: [{kind: day, date}, {kind: priority, priority}, {kind: list, list: n or null}]. list_reorder{list,before?,after?}, list_sort{list,sort}, list_group{list,group_by}. Expectations: views.<name> is [[group name, [titles]]] for today, upcoming, inbox, all and list0, list1, ... (the created Lists); group names are plain, overdue, p1..p4, list:<name or Inbox>, day:<date>, due:<overdue|today|tomorrow|week|later|no_date> and no_date_in_list. reorder_ops: the change-log ops each reorder step recorded. Other keys are as in todo-rules.json.
